for: shotlist.json · Brewly: before you run out (15 s ad / launch teaser, 9:16 lead; optional 16:9 re-layout)

tone.why: a social launch teaser with a wry gag in the hook: springy, warm shapes, one sharp hit at the reveal

motion.personality: The morning hurries; Brewly never does. Springy props, a hold after every key action, one wow at the reveal.
motion.easing: soft (power2/sine) for props and cards; a back-out pop only on the reveal word mark

9:16.hero_band: props sit centred in y 700-1240; type sits in y 300-700

16:9.hero_third: right (props), type in the left two thirds

look.note: flat, drawn props (no footage): the grade is recorded for consistency, but the ad template has no grade key, so only vignette + grain are applied (layers)

hero_by_shot.s01: the upside-down kraft bag and the three falling beans
hero_by_shot.s04: the lit phone notification, then the Brewly word mark
hero_by_shot.s05: the line 'Coffee that never runs out.'
hero_by_shot.s06: the bean gauge flipping to 'Next bag shipped'

cover.subject: the upside-down bag over the empty mug, beans mid-fall

labels.style: IBM Plex Mono 600, 30 px, palette.muted (muted_on_night on dark shots), letter-spacing 0.02em, bottom-left of the safe rect (x 65, baseline y 1236)
labels.schedule: one label line from the reveal (5.0 s) to the end, its text following the shot list: s04-s05 'Fictional app · concept', s06 'Fictional app · demo screen', s07 'Fictional brand · concept teaser'
labels.deviation: the end-card wording is on screen 2.5 s, under the 3 s fine-print default, because the ad template's 15 s CTA budget is 2.5 s; the word 'Fictional' stays on screen continuously for 10 s (5.0-15.0 s)

frames.world: a warm kitchen counter at dawn, drawn flat: espresso-brown night for the problem, cream paper for cards and the end card

templates/ad.type.headline: motion.type_presets.headline
templates/ad.layers: look (grain stock upload-safe + vignette as overlay kinds)

handoff.template: templates/ad (closest: hook > problem > product > proof > CTA)
cannot_express_yet: 9:16: the ad template's make.mjs is fixed at 1920x1080 and has no aspect key; motion-pack must re-lay it out for 1080x1920
the hook/problem/reveal pictures: the template plays video plates (the 'Orbit' desk demo); Brewly needs drawn props (bag, beans, mug, phone, app screen)
palette.night / accent_on_night / muted_on_night / success / kraft have no CONFIG keys
grade name (warm-film) and the label style have no CONFIG keys
